Kenya's President William Ruto has completed 2,157 housing units in Eldoret City at a cost of $40.8 million.

He has handed over the keys to the homes to the new homeowners.

It includes 104 shops, a kindergarten, playgrounds, green open spaces, a clubhouse and a swimming pool. h

Investors from 90 countries have subscribed to Dangote Refinery's IPO (Initial Public Offering).

This includes investors from 51 African countries.
